# ComfyUI Studio — compatibility/optimization notes
WD14 tagging is supplementary and does not modify the Qwen captions or generated output. For character detection, inspect the WD14 tags. High-confidence matches can be applied manually, or integrated programmatically into ComfyUI Studio later. This graph intentionally retains original model files, sampler settings, and FreeOllamaVRAM hooks. Qwen captioner verified operational on Ollama (localhost:11434); automatic input downscaling prevents HTTP 400 context-overflow errors. LoRA 2 (Jill Valentine) is bypassed by default to avoid contaminating non-Jill reference images.

nodes.title: MODEL GUIDE — SDXL / PONY XL — READ BEFORE SELECTING
widgets_values:
# MODEL FAMILY: SDXL / PONY XL

**Compatible model examples / model location:**
sdxlPhotorealisticMix_v10.safetensors / gonzalomoXLFluxPony_v70PhotoXL.safetensors

**Important:** SDXL/Pony LoRAs only; do not select SD 1.5 checkpoints or Krea DiT files.

**Ollama caption model vs image model:** In `Qwen3VLAbliteratedPromptPair`, `huihui_ai/qwen3-vl-abliterated:8b-instruct` is an **Ollama image-analysis model**, not your generation checkpoint.

**ComfyUI limitation:** Standard dropdowns still list all matching file types from shared folders; this note and labeled loader indicate what is appropriate, but do not restrict dropdown contents.
